description.value: Sushi Village is a landmark Japanese restaurant in Whistler Village that has been serving sushi, sashimi, and Japanese cuisine since December 1985, making it one of the earliest restaurants in the resort town. Founded by three friends who moved to Whistler to ski and never left, it has grown into a beloved local institution known for its warm service and often boisterous atmosphere. The restaurant offers an extensive menu including gluten-free and vegetarian options, with both dine-in and phone-in takeout available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from sushivillage.com is the primary evidence source; the /contact/ subpage provides the address (4340 Sundial Crescent, Whistler, BC V0N 1B4) and phone (+1 604 932 3330), neither of which appear in the OSM record. Takeout is confirmed via the /order-out/ page and a dedicated gluten-free/vegetarian menu is confirmed via the /menu/ page; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The website also contains apparent injected casino spam links, though the core business content appears legitimate.
